QuestInfo.name: [Silent Crusade] First Mission
QuestInfo.0: Ask Lora, the Silent Crusader dispatched to #m260010201#, for a rundown of the situation.
QuestInfo.1: Enter the Mystic Gate in #m260010201# and eliminate Deo.
QuestInfo.2: A strange shadow passed by when you eliminated Deo. What could that have been?

0.0: Good to see you here. I've been keeping an eye on Nihal Desert with Sun and found a strange gate. I hear you've seen this kind of gate before! Can you poke your head in and see what's inside?

yes.0: Great. Be sure to wipe out any monsters you find. Ooh, and don't get clobbered!

no.0: Getting those first mission jitters? You're not what I expected from what Starling told me. Guess I expected too much.

1.0: Good work! So, what was it like in there?

yes.0: You saw a shadow when Deo went down? I'll make a note of that. Anyway, I got a call from Starling while you were in there. Looks like your next mission is up.

mob.0: If you find stranger monsters in the #m260010201# gate, just go ahead and get rid of them. I know this is your first mission, but don't worry too much. It's just business as usual!
